GAP LE PA Sync Exported Functions

group GAP_LE_PA_SYNC_Exported_Functions

Functions

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_init(uint8_t sync_handle_num)

Initialize the number of sync handles for synchronization state in periodic advertising.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_init(sync_handle_num);
}

备注

If PA synchronization state will be used, le_ext_scan_gap_msg_info_way (false) should be invoked.

参数:

sync_handle_num -- [in] Sync handle number.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_get_param(T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PARAM_TYPE param, void *p_value, uint8_t sync_id)

Get GAP PA sync parameters.

This function can be called with a PA sync parameter type T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PARAM_TYPE and it will get the PA sync parameter. The 'p_value' field must point to an appropriate data type that meets the requirements for the corresponding parameter type. (For example, if required data length for parameter type is 2 octets, p_value should be cast to a pointer of uint16_t.)

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
     uint8_t periodic_adv_list_size = 0;
     T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_get_param(PA_SYNC_PARAM_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_SIZE, &periodic_adv_list_size, 0xFF);
}

void app_handle_pa_sync_state_evt()
{

     {
       T_GAP_PA_SYNC_COMMON_SYNC_PARAM common_sync_param;

       if (le_pa_sync_get_param(PA_SYNC_PARAM_SYNCHRONIZED_PARAM, &common_sync_param, sync_id) == GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS)
       ......
}

参数:

  • param -- [in] GAP PA sync parameter types T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PARAM_TYPE.

  • p_value -- [inout] Pointer to location to get the parameter value.

  • sync_id -- [in] - If param is PA_SYNC_PARAM_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_SIZE or PA_SYNC_PARAM_DEV_STATE, sync_id is irrelevant.

    • If param is PA_SYNC_PARAM_SYNCHRONIZED_PARAM, sync_id identify the periodic advertising train.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Operation success.

  • Others -- Operation failure.

返回:

Operation result.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_terminate_sync(uint8_t sync_id)

Stop reception of the periodic advertising train, or cancel the synchronization creation while it is pending.

If sending request operation is successful, the result of stop reception or cancel pending synchronization creation will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_DEV_STATE_CHANGE_INFO, GAP PA synchronization states will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_STATE_CHANGE_INFO.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_terminate_sync(sync_id);
}

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_modify_periodic_adv_list(T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_OP operation, uint8_t *adv_addr, T_GAP_PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_TYPE adv_addr_type, uint8_t adv_sid)

Modify Periodic Advertiser list.

If sending request operation is successful, the result of modifying Periodic Advertiser list will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_MODIFY_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_modify_periodic_adv_list(operation, adv_addr, adv_addr_type, adv_sid);
}

T_APP_RESULT app_gap_callback(uint8_t cb_type, void *p_cb_data)
{
    T_APP_RESULT result = APP_RESULT_SUCCESS;
    T_LE_CB_DATA *p_data = (T_LE_CB_DATA *)p_cb_data;

    .......
    switch (cb_type)
    {
    case GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_MODIFY_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST:
        APP_PRINT_INFO2("GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_MODIFY_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST: operation %d, cause 0x%x",
                        p_data->p_le_pa_sync_modify_periodic_adv_list_rsp->operation,
                        p_data->p_le_pa_sync_modify_periodic_adv_list_rsp->cause);
        break;
    ......
    }
}

备注

This function to add, remove or clear Periodic Advertiser list can be called after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

参数:

  • operation -- [in] Add entry to Periodic Advertiser list, remove entry from Periodic Advertiser list or clear all entries from Periodic Advertiser list. T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_OP. If operation is GAP_PA_SYNC_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_OP_CLEAR, adv_addr, adv_addr_type and adv_sid are irrelevant.

  • adv_addr -- [in] Pointer to Public Device Address, Random Device Address, Public Identity Address, or Random (static) Identity Address of the advertiser.

  • adv_addr_type -- [in] Only PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_PUBLIC and PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_RANDOM could be used for modifying Periodic Advertiser list.

  • adv_sid -- [in] Advertising SID subfield in the ADI field used to identify the Periodic Advertising.

返回值:

  • GAP_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Sending request operation is successful.

  • Others -- Sending request operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending request.

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_create_sync(T_GAP_PA_SYNC_CREATE_SYNC_PARAM *p_pa_sync_create_sync_param, uint8_t *p_sync_id)

Synchronize with a periodic advertising train from an advertiser.

This function can be called after Bluetooth Host is ready.

Explanation: If Bluetooth Host is ready, the application will be notified by message GAP_MSG_LE_DEV_STATE_CHANGE with new_state about gap_init_state which is configured as GAP_INIT_STATE_STACK_READY.

If sending request operation is successful, the result of synchronization creation will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_DEV_STATE_CHANGE_INFO, GAP PA synchronization states will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_STATE_CHANGE_INFO. Periodic advertisement will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PERIODIC_ADV_REPORT_INFO.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_PA_SYNC_CREATE_SYNC_PARAM pa_create_sync_param;
    memset(&pa_create_sync_param, 0, sizeof(T_GAP_PA_SYNC_CREATE_SYNC_PARAM));
    uint8_t sync_id = GAP_INVALID_SYNC_ID;

    ......
    // Initialization of pa_create_sync_param is dependent on Application.

    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_create_sync(&pa_create_sync_param, &sync_id);
}

T_GAP_CAUSE le_pa_sync_set_periodic_adv_receive_enable(uint8_t sync_id, uint8_t enable)

Enable or disable reports for specified periodic advertising train.

If sending request operation is successful, the result enable or disable reports will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_DEV_STATE_CHANGE_INFO, GAP_MSG_LE_PA_SYNC_SET_PERIODIC_ADV_RECEIVE_ENABLE. Periodic advertisement will be returned by the callback function with msg type GAP_MSG_LE_PERIODIC_ADV_REPORT_INFO.

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    T_GAP_CAUSE cause = le_pa_sync_set_periodic_adv_receive_enable(sync_id, enable);
}
